fields.label: Section
fields.description: The heading this line sits under on the paper form.

fields.label: Unit of Issue
fields.description: The form's unit, e.g. Pack of 30, Cycle, Vial, Test.

fields.label: Our Item
fields.description: The hospital's stock item. Leave empty while it is not stocked: the line prints as not mapped.

fields.label: Stock Units per Unit of Issue
fields.description: How many of the item's stock units make one of the form's units (e.g. 30 tablets = 1 pack).
